description: Site admins only (needs an 'admin'-scoped token). Import a third-party GitHub Action at ONE tag, branch or full commit SHA into the Gluecron mirror namespace (gluecron-actions/<owner>--<repo>), so workflows that say `uses: owner/repo@ref` can run it. Workflow runs never fetch from github.com; an action that is not imported is skipped. Re-importing the same ref updates it to what upstream has now. Audit-logged. Returns {action, ref, sha, previousSha, mirror, upstreamUrl, hasActionYml}.

action.description: Upstream action as workflows write it, e.g. actions/github-script

ref.description: Tag, branch or full commit SHA, e.g. v7

name: gluecron_import_action
